messages:
Ollie: Tiny PSA  my birthday is next Wednesday. If anyone's around and wants to do a 10-min 'snack & shoutouts' I'd be into it, otherwise totally chill.
people-ops-bot: Reminder: Post birthday celebration plans and sign-ups in #people-ops. Shared sheet: https://tinyurl.com/rwd-bday-helpers
Renee: I can grab a couple boxes of mini eclairs and a small 'congrats' banner. Voting react: :eclair: eclairs, :cupcake: cupcakes, :cookies: cookies.
Kai: I'll bring sparkling water + fancy tea. Quick poll: 2:30pm or 4pm? React with :two-thirty: or :four:.
Maya: I'm remote but happy to send a 5-8s silly clip if you want to play it. Also down to chip in for a tiny plant.
Jon: I vote 2:30 so it's a mid-afternoon pick-me-up. Also can handwrite a card.
Ollie: 2:30 works great. No chocolate (allergies) but otherwise surprise away. Also low-key is perfect, love the eclair idea.
Renee: Ordering eclairs (nut-free) now. ETA office 2:20pm. Adding a little gluten-free box too.
people-ops-bot: people-ops notified  suggested per-person contribution $5-15. Sign-up updated by Renee. Last edit: 1865432140.
Kai: Reserved break table 2:25-2:45pm PT. Zoom link for remote folks added to calendar invite.
Maya: Sent my clip and a goofy GIF. Can't wait.
Jon: Card copy: "Happy birthday Ollie! Thanks for the endless emoji reactions and sane debugging advice."
Ollie: You absolute pests, this is perfect. See you at 2:30 (virtually if remote) 389
